evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.
Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

observations.why: Quinton articulates a bedrock operational rule and an identity/creed-level axiom establishing that unrehearsed capabilities do not genuinely exist.
Records the operational decision and scheduled cadence as an established working rule.
Records the definitive ownership assignment for the rehearsal schedule.
